CustomField.description: Date the grant engine populated this row's entitlement. Idempotency guard for LeaveManagementController: a row with a value here is not granted again. Replaces Annual_Leave_Granted_Year__c and Refresh_Leave_Granted_Year__c on User, which cannot be used any more - writing a guard on User (a setup object) in the same transaction as a Leave_Balance__c write would throw MIXED_DML_OPERATION. Blank means entitlement has not been granted for this type and year yet, which is the normal state for a Refreshment row before the anniversary.
CustomField.label: Granted On
